# Duaer

> The Duaer skill catalog lists call skills you can paste into an agent. Opening the catalog does not search and does not use credits.

Chinese index: [llms.txt](https://skills.duaer.com/zh/llms.txt).

## Skills

- [Search papers in Duaer](https://skills.duaer.com/papers.md): In Duaer, search published papers. One successful search uses 1 credit.
- [Search proteins in Duaer](https://skills.duaer.com/proteins.md): In Duaer, search genes and proteins. One successful search uses 1 credit.
- [Search clinical trials in Duaer](https://skills.duaer.com/trials.md): In Duaer, search clinical trials. One successful search uses 1 credit.
- [Search compounds in Duaer](https://skills.duaer.com/compounds.md): In Duaer, search compounds and drugs. One successful search uses 1 credit.
- [Search protein structures in Duaer](https://skills.duaer.com/structures.md): In Duaer, search protein structures. One successful search uses 1 credit.
- [Search diseases in Duaer](https://skills.duaer.com/diseases.md): In Duaer, search UniProt disease names. One successful search uses 1 credit.
- [Search organisms in Duaer](https://skills.duaer.com/organisms.md): In Duaer, search UniProt taxonomy. One successful search uses 1 credit.
- [Search keywords in Duaer](https://skills.duaer.com/keywords.md): In Duaer, search UniProt keywords. One successful search uses 1 credit.
- [Search locations in Duaer](https://skills.duaer.com/locations.md): In Duaer, search UniProt subcellular locations. One successful search uses 1 credit.
- [Search Gene Ontology in Duaer](https://skills.duaer.com/gene-ontology.md): In Duaer, search Gene Ontology terms. One successful search uses 1 credit.
- [Search pathways in Duaer](https://skills.duaer.com/pathways.md): In Duaer, search Reactome pathways. One successful search uses 1 credit.
- [Search genes in Duaer](https://skills.duaer.com/genes.md): In Duaer, search genes. One successful search uses 1 credit.
- [Search variants in Duaer](https://skills.duaer.com/variants.md): In Duaer, search variants (ClinVar / dbSNP). One successful search uses 1 credit.
- [Search domains in Duaer](https://skills.duaer.com/domains.md): In Duaer, search InterPro domains. One successful search uses 1 credit.
- [Search preprints in Duaer](https://skills.duaer.com/preprints.md): In Duaer, search bioRxiv and medRxiv preprints via Europe PMC. One successful search uses 1 credit.
- [Search grants in Duaer](https://skills.duaer.com/grants.md): In Duaer, search NIH grants via RePORTER. One successful search uses 1 credit.

- [Search targets in Duaer](https://skills.duaer.com/targets.md): In Duaer, search Open Targets gene–disease associations. One successful search uses 1 credit.

- [Search activities in Duaer](https://skills.duaer.com/activities.md): In Duaer, search ChEMBL bioactivities by molecule or target. One successful search uses 1 credit.
- [Search tissue atlas in Duaer](https://skills.duaer.com/atlas.md): In Duaer, search Human Protein Atlas tissue-enriched expression. One successful search uses 1 credit.
- [Search indications in Duaer](https://skills.duaer.com/indications.md): In Duaer, search ChEMBL drug indications by molecule. One successful search uses 1 credit.
- [Search mechanisms in Duaer](https://skills.duaer.com/mechanisms.md): In Duaer, search ChEMBL mechanisms of action by molecule. One successful search uses 1 credit.
- [Search GEO in Duaer](https://skills.duaer.com/geo.md): In Duaer, search NCBI GEO series and datasets. One successful search uses 1 credit.
- [Search assays in Duaer](https://skills.duaer.com/assays.md): In Duaer, search ChEMBL assays by words or assay id. One successful search uses 1 credit.
- [Search patents in Duaer](https://skills.duaer.com/patents.md): In Duaer, search patents via Europe PMC. One successful search uses 1 credit.
- [Look up AlphaFold structures in Duaer](https://skills.duaer.com/alphafold.md): In Duaer, look up AlphaFold predicted structures by gene or UniProt accession. One successful search uses 1 credit.
- [Search cell lines in Duaer](https://skills.duaer.com/cell-lines.md): In Duaer, search cell lines via Cellosaurus. One successful search uses 1 credit.
- [Search drug–gene interactions in Duaer](https://skills.duaer.com/drug-gene.md): In Duaer, search drug–gene interactions via DGIdb. One successful search uses 1 credit.

- [Get a Duaer key](https://skills.duaer.com/keys.md): A Duaer key authorizes calls to the Duaer data API. Create it after you sign in. The full value is shown once.

# Duaer

> Duaer 技能目录列出可复制给智能体的调用技能。打开目录不检索，也不扣额度。

中文索引在本文件。英文索引：[llms.txt](https://skills.duaer.com/llms.txt)。

## 技能

- [在 Duaer 里检索论文](https://skills.duaer.com/zh/papers.md): 在 Duaer 里检索已发表论文。一次成功查询用 1 额度。
- [在 Duaer 里检索基因和蛋白](https://skills.duaer.com/zh/proteins.md): 在 Duaer 里检索基因和蛋白。一次成功查询用 1 额度。
- [在 Duaer 里检索临床试验](https://skills.duaer.com/zh/trials.md): 在 Duaer 里检索临床试验。一次成功查询用 1 额度。
- [在 Duaer 里检索化合物和药物](https://skills.duaer.com/zh/compounds.md): 在 Duaer 里检索化合物和药物。一次成功查询用 1 额度。
- [在 Duaer 里检索蛋白结构](https://skills.duaer.com/zh/structures.md): 在 Duaer 里检索蛋白结构。一次成功查询用 1 额度。
- [在 Duaer 里检索疾病](https://skills.duaer.com/zh/diseases.md): 在 Duaer 里检索 UniProt 疾病名称。一次成功查询用 1 额度。
- [在 Duaer 里检索物种](https://skills.duaer.com/zh/organisms.md): 在 Duaer 里检索 UniProt 物种分类。一次成功查询用 1 额度。
- [在 Duaer 里检索关键词](https://skills.duaer.com/zh/keywords.md): 在 Duaer 里检索 UniProt 关键词。一次成功查询用 1 额度。
- [在 Duaer 里检索亚细胞定位](https://skills.duaer.com/zh/locations.md): 在 Duaer 里检索 UniProt 亚细胞定位。一次成功查询用 1 额度。
- [在 Duaer 里检索基因本体](https://skills.duaer.com/zh/gene-ontology.md): 在 Duaer 里检索 Gene Ontology 术语。一次成功查询用 1 额度。
- [在 Duaer 里检索通路](https://skills.duaer.com/zh/pathways.md): 在 Duaer 里检索 Reactome 通路。一次成功查询用 1 额度。
- [在 Duaer 里检索基因](https://skills.duaer.com/zh/genes.md): 在 Duaer 里检索基因。一次成功查询用 1 额度。
- [在 Duaer 里检索变异](https://skills.duaer.com/zh/variants.md): 在 Duaer 里检索变异（ClinVar / dbSNP）。一次成功查询用 1 额度。
- [在 Duaer 里检索结构域](https://skills.duaer.com/zh/domains.md): 在 Duaer 里检索 InterPro 结构域。一次成功查询用 1 额度。
- [在 Duaer 里检索预印本](https://skills.duaer.com/zh/preprints.md): 在 Duaer 里经 Europe PMC 检索 bioRxiv / medRxiv 预印本。一次成功查询用 1 额度。
- [在 Duaer 里检索基金](https://skills.duaer.com/zh/grants.md): 在 Duaer 里经 NIH RePORTER 检索基金与项目。一次成功查询用 1 额度。
- [在 Duaer 里检索互作](https://skills.duaer.com/zh/interactions.md): 在 Duaer 里经 STRING 检索蛋白互作伙伴。一次成功查询用 1 额度。
- [在 Duaer 里检索表达](https://skills.duaer.com/zh/expression.md): 在 Duaer 里经 GTEx 检索组织中位表达。一次成功查询用 1 额度。
- [在 Duaer 里检索靶点关联](https://skills.duaer.com/zh/targets.md): 在 Duaer 里经 Open Targets 检索基因–疾病关联。一次成功查询用 1 额度。
- [在 Duaer 里检索同源基因](https://skills.duaer.com/zh/orthologs.md): 在 Duaer 里经 MyGene HomoloGene 检索跨物种同源基因。一次成功查询用 1 额度。
- [在 Duaer 里检索生物活性](https://skills.duaer.com/zh/activities.md): 在 Duaer 里经 ChEMBL 按分子或靶点检索生物活性。一次成功查询用 1 额度。
- [在 Duaer 里检索组织图谱](https://skills.duaer.com/zh/atlas.md): 在 Duaer 里经 Human Protein Atlas 检索组织富集表达。一次成功查询用 1 额度。
- [在 Duaer 里检索适应症](https://skills.duaer.com/zh/indications.md): 在 Duaer 里经 ChEMBL 按分子检索药物适应症。一次成功查询用 1 额度。
- [在 Duaer 里检索作用机制](https://skills.duaer.com/zh/mechanisms.md): 在 Duaer 里经 ChEMBL 按分子检索作用机制。一次成功查询用 1 额度。
- [在 Duaer 里检索 GEO](https://skills.duaer.com/zh/geo.md): 在 Duaer 里检索 NCBI GEO 系列与数据集。一次成功查询用 1 额度。
- [在 Duaer 里检索实验测定](https://skills.duaer.com/zh/assays.md): 在 Duaer 里按关键词或 id 检索 ChEMBL 实验测定。一次成功查询用 1 额度。
- [在 Duaer 里检索专利](https://skills.duaer.com/zh/patents.md): 在 Duaer 里经 Europe PMC 检索专利。一次成功查询用 1 额度。
- [在 Duaer 里查询 AlphaFold 预测结构](https://skills.duaer.com/zh/alphafold.md): 在 Duaer 里按基因或 UniProt 编号查询 AlphaFold 预测结构。一次成功查询用 1 额度。
- [在 Duaer 里检索细胞系](https://skills.duaer.com/zh/cell-lines.md): 在 Duaer 里经 Cellosaurus 检索细胞系。一次成功查询用 1 额度。
- [在 Duaer 里检索药–基因互作](https://skills.duaer.com/zh/drug-gene.md): 在 Duaer 里经 DGIdb 检索药–基因互作。一次成功查询用 1 额度。
- [在 Duaer 里检索生化反应](https://skills.duaer.com/zh/reactions.md): 在 Duaer 里经 Rhea 检索生化反应。一次成功查询用 1 额度。
- [在 Duaer 里检索蛋白复合物](https://skills.duaer.com/zh/complexes.md): 在 Duaer 里经 Complex Portal 检索蛋白复合物。一次成功查询用 1 额度。
- [在 Duaer 里检索代谢物](https://skills.duaer.com/zh/metabolites.md): 在 Duaer 里经 ChEBI 检索代谢物。一次成功查询用 1 额度。
- [在 Duaer 里检索药品标签](https://skills.duaer.com/zh/drug-labels.md): 在 Duaer 里经 OpenFDA 检索 FDA 药品标签。一次成功查询用 1 额度。
- [在 Duaer 里检索不良反应](https://skills.duaer.com/zh/adverse-events.md): 在 Duaer 里经 OpenFDA FAERS 检索 FDA 不良反应报告。一次成功查询用 1 额度。
- [在 Duaer 里检索 GWAS](https://skills.duaer.com/zh/gwas.md): 在 Duaer 里经 GWAS Catalog REST API v2 检索关联。一次成功查询用 1 额度。
- [在 Duaer 里检索 RxNorm](https://skills.duaer.com/zh/rxnorm.md): 在 Duaer 里经 RxNorm（NLM RxNav）检索药名。一次成功查询用 1 额度。
- [在 Duaer 里检索 MeSH](https://skills.duaer.com/zh/mesh.md): 在 Duaer 里经 MeSH（NLM）检索主题词。一次成功查询用 1 额度。
- [在 Duaer 里检索表型](https://skills.duaer.com/zh/phenotypes.md): 在 Duaer 里经 HPO（EBI OLS）检索表型术语。一次成功查询用 1 额度。
- [在 Duaer 里检索交叉引用](https://skills.duaer.com/zh/crossrefs.md): 在 Duaer 里经 UniChem 按 InChIKey 检索化合物交叉引用。一次成功查询用 1 额度。
- [在 Duaer 里检索药品召回](https://skills.duaer.com/zh/drug-recalls.md): 在 Duaer 里经 OpenFDA 检索药品召回执法报告。一次成功查询用 1 额度。
- [在 Duaer 里检索配体](https://skills.duaer.com/zh/ligands.md): 在 Duaer 里经 PDBe 查阅化学组分（CCD）配体。一次成功查询用 1 额度。
- [在 Duaer 里检索 ChEMBL](https://skills.duaer.com/zh/chembl.md): 在 Duaer 里经 ChEMBL 检索生物活性分子。一次成功查询用 1 额度。
- [在 Duaer 里检索 Ensembl](https://skills.duaer.com/zh/ensembl.md): 在 Duaer 里经 Ensembl 按基因符号或编号查阅基因。一次成功查询用 1 额度。

- [在 Duaer 里获取调用密钥](https://skills.duaer.com/zh/keys.md): Duaer 密钥用来调用 Duaer 数据接口。登录后创建。完整密钥只显示一次。

> Index: [llms.txt](https://skills.duaer.com/llms.txt). This page as Markdown: https://skills.duaer.com/keys.md

# Get a Duaer key

A Duaer key authorizes calls to the Duaer data API. Create it after you sign in. The full value is shown once.

1. Sign in to [Duaer](https://www.duaer.com/signin).
2. Open [Settings → Model API key](https://www.duaer.com/settings/model-api-key).
3. Create a key and copy it.
4. Send `Authorization: Bearer <Duaer key>`.

An admin can also create an account key at [Admin → API](https://www.duaer.com/admin/api).

Opening the Duaer skill catalog does not search and does not use credits.

> 索引：[llms.txt](https://skills.duaer.com/zh/llms.txt)。本页 Markdown：https://skills.duaer.com/zh/keys.md

# 在 Duaer 里获取调用密钥

在 Duaer 里，密钥用来调用数据接口。登录后创建。完整密钥只显示一次。

1. 打开 [Duaer 登录](https://www.duaer.com/signin)。
2. 进入 [设置里的模型 API 密钥](https://www.duaer.com/settings/model-api-key)。
3. 新建一把密钥，立刻复制。
4. 请求头使用 `Authorization: Bearer <Duaer key>`。

管理员也可以在 [管理里的 API 密钥](https://www.duaer.com/admin/api) 生成账号密钥。

打开 Duaer 技能目录不检索，也不扣额度。

---
name: duaer-papers
description: >-
  Search published papers through Duaer. One successful search uses 1 Duaer credit.
---

# Duaer papers

Search published papers through Duaer. One successful search uses 1 Duaer credit.

## Call

`GET https://api.duaer.com/v1/data/papers?title=lithium&author=Zhang&yearFrom=2020&yearTo=2024&limit=10`

Header: `Authorization: Bearer <Duaer key>`

Use an account key or a model API key.

Get a Duaer key: https://skills.duaer.com/keys.md

- `q` — words in the title, abstract, or full text.
- `title` — words in the title.
- `abstract` — words in the abstract.
- `author` — author name.
- `yearFrom`, `yearTo` — publication year. Leave a year out, or send `0`, for any year. A set year is from 1000 to 2100.
- `type` — work type, such as `article`, `preprint`, or `review`.
- `openAccess` — `yes` or `no`.
- `citationsFrom`, `citationsTo` — citation count. `0` means no bound.
- `language` — code such as `en` or `zh`.
- `doi` — digital object identifier.
- `journal`, `institution`, `topic` — names. Duaer uses the closest match.
- `sort` — `citations` orders by most cited. Omit it for relevance.
- `limit` — optional. From 1 to 20. Default 10.

## Result

Each item includes `source`, `title`, `url`, and `summary`, plus the fields named on this skill.

## Credits

One successful search uses 1 credit.
An empty search, a failed search, a compound that matches nothing, or no remaining credits uses 0.
No remaining credits returns 402 and does not search.
A missing key returns 401.

name: duaer-proteins
description: >-
  Search genes and proteins through Duaer. One successful search uses 1 Duaer credit.

# Duaer proteins

Search genes and proteins through Duaer. One successful search uses 1 Duaer credit.

## Call

`GET https://api.duaer.com/v1/data/proteins?gene=INS&organism=Homo%20sapiens&reviewed=yes&limit=10`

Header: `Authorization: Bearer <Duaer key>`

Use an account key or a model API key.

Get a Duaer key: https://skills.duaer.com/keys.md

- At least one search field is required. Fields combine.
- `q` — words in the protein record.
- `gene` — gene symbol. Look up symbols with https://skills.duaer.com/genes.md.
- `name` — protein name.
- `organism` — organism name. Look up formal names with https://skills.duaer.com/organisms.md.
- `accession` — accession.
- `reviewed` — `yes` or `no`.
- `lengthFrom`, `lengthTo` — sequence length. `0` means no bound.
- `disease` — disease name. Look up formal names with https://skills.duaer.com/diseases.md.
- `keyword` — UniProt keyword. Look up formal names with https://skills.duaer.com/keywords.md.
- `location` — subcellular location. Look up formal names with https://skills.duaer.com/locations.md.
- `function` — words in the function text.
- `go` — Gene Ontology term. Look up terms with https://skills.duaer.com/gene-ontology.md.
- `pathway` — Reactome pathway id or words. Look up pathways with https://skills.duaer.com/pathways.md.
- `domain` — InterPro domain id or words. Look up domains with https://skills.duaer.com/domains.md.
- `taxonomyId` — NCBI taxonomy id. Look up ids with https://skills.duaer.com/organisms.md.
- `limit` — optional. From 1 to 20. Default 10.

## Result

Each item includes `source`, `title`, `url`, and `summary`, plus the fields named on this skill.

## Credits

One successful search uses 1 credit.
An empty search, a failed search, a compound that matches nothing, or no remaining credits uses 0.
No remaining credits returns 402 and does not search.
A missing key returns 401.

# Duaer trials

Search clinical trials through Duaer. One successful search uses 1 Duaer credit.

## Call

`GET https://api.duaer.com/v1/data/trials?condition=diabetes&intervention=insulin&status=RECRUITING&limit=10`

Header: `Authorization: Bearer <Duaer key>`

Use an account key or a model API key.

Get a Duaer key: https://skills.duaer.com/keys.md

- At least one search field is required. Sort alone is not a search. Fields combine.
- `condition` — disease or condition.
- `term` — other words.
- `intervention` — drug, device, or other intervention.
- `location` — where the study runs.
- `title` — words in the title.
- `outcome` — words in the outcome.
- `sponsor` — sponsor name.
- `lead` — lead sponsor name.
- `nctId` — study id.
- `status` — recruitment status, such as `RECRUITING` or `COMPLETED`.
- `phase` — `EARLY_PHASE1`, `PHASE1`, `PHASE2`, `PHASE3`, `PHASE4`, or `NA`.
- `sort` — `recent` orders by last update. Omit it for relevance.
- `limit` — optional. From 1 to 20. Default 10.

## Result

Each item includes `source`, `title`, `url`, and `summary`, plus the fields named on this skill.

## Credits

One successful search uses 1 credit.
An empty search, a failed search, a compound that matches nothing, or no remaining credits uses 0.
No remaining credits returns 402 and does not search.
A missing key returns 401.

- `limit` — optional. From 1 to 20. Default 10. A name can return several compounds up to this limit.

# Duaer structures

Search protein structures through Duaer. One successful search uses 1 Duaer credit.

## Call

`GET https://api.duaer.com/v1/data/structures?q=insulin&organism=Homo%20sapiens&method=X-RAY%20DIFFRACTION&resolutionTo=2.5&limit=10`

Header: `Authorization: Bearer <Duaer key>`

Use an account key or a model API key.

Get a Duaer key: https://skills.duaer.com/keys.md

- At least one search field is required. Fields combine.
- `q` — words in the structure record.
- `pdbId` — structure id, such as `4HHB`.
- `organism` — scientific name. Look up formal names with https://skills.duaer.com/organisms.md.
- `method` — experimental method, such as `X-RAY DIFFRACTION`, `SOLUTION NMR`, or `ELECTRON MICROSCOPY`.
- `resolutionFrom`, `resolutionTo` — resolution in angstroms. `0` means no bound.
- `releasedFrom`, `releasedTo` — release date as `YYYY-MM-DD`.
- `polymer` — `protein`, `dna`, or `rna`.
- `ligand` — bound chemical name.
- `limit` — optional. From 1 to 20. Default 10.

## Result

Each item includes `source`, `title`, `url`, and `summary`, plus the fields named on this skill.

## Credits

One successful search uses 1 credit.
An empty search, a failed search, a compound that matches nothing, or no remaining credits uses 0.
No remaining credits returns 402 and does not search.
A missing key returns 401.

# Duaer diseases

Search disease names through Duaer. Use the formal name with proteins.disease. One successful search uses 1 Duaer credit.

## Call

`GET https://api.duaer.com/v1/data/diseases?q=diabetes&limit=10`

Header: `Authorization: Bearer <Duaer key>`

Use an account key or a model API key.

Get a Duaer key: https://skills.duaer.com/keys.md

- At least one search field is required. Fields combine.
- Search with `q` first; use `id` or `acronym` only when you already have them from a result.
- `q` — words in the disease name or definition.
- `id` — optional. UniProt disease id from a result (`diseaseId`), such as `DI-02060`.
- `name` — optional. Disease name.
- `acronym` — optional. Disease acronym from a result, such as `T2D`.
- `limit` — optional. From 1 to 20. Default 10.
- Use `title` as `disease` when searching proteins. Reuse `diseaseId` in `id` for an exact lookup.

## Result

Each item includes `source`, `title`, `url`, and `summary`, plus the fields named on this skill.

## Credits

One successful search uses 1 credit.
An empty search, a failed search, a compound that matches nothing, or no remaining credits uses 0.

# Duaer organisms

Search organism names through Duaer. Use the scientific name with proteins.organism and structures.organism. One successful search uses 1 Duaer credit.

## Call

`GET https://api.duaer.com/v1/data/organisms?q=human&limit=10`

Header: `Authorization: Bearer <Duaer key>`

Use an account key or a model API key.

Get a Duaer key: https://skills.duaer.com/keys.md

- At least one search field is required. Fields combine.
- Search with `q` first; use `taxonId` only when you already have it from a result.
- `q` — words in the scientific or common name.
- `taxonId` — optional. NCBI / UniProt taxon id from a result (`taxonId`), such as `9606`.
- `scientific` — optional. Scientific name, such as `Homo sapiens`.
- `common` — optional. Common name, such as `human`.
- `limit` — optional. From 1 to 20. Default 10.
- Use `title` (scientific name) as `organism` when searching proteins or structures. Reuse `taxonId` as `taxonomyId` on proteins.

## Result

Each item includes `source`, `title`, `url`, and `summary`, plus the fields named on this skill.

## Credits

One successful search uses 1 credit.
An empty search, a failed search, a compound that matches nothing, or no remaining credits uses 0.

description: >-
  Search Gene Ontology terms through Duaer. Use the name or id with proteins.go. One successful search uses 1 Duaer credit.
---

# Duaer Gene Ontology

Search Gene Ontology terms through Duaer. Use the name or id with proteins.go. One successful search uses 1 Duaer credit.

## Call

`GET https://api.duaer.com/v1/data/gene-ontology?q=apoptosis&limit=10`

Header: `Authorization: Bearer <Duaer key>`

Use an account key or a model API key.

Get a Duaer key: https://skills.duaer.com/keys.md

- At least one search field is required. Fields combine.
- Search with `q` first; use `id` only when you already have it from a result.
- `q` — words in the term name or definition.
- `id` — optional. Gene Ontology id from a result (`goId`), such as `GO:0006915`.
- `name` — optional. Term name.
- `limit` — optional. From 1 to 20. Default 10.
- Use `title` or `goId` as `go` when searching proteins. Reuse `goId` in `id` for an exact lookup.

## Result

Each item includes `source`, `title`, `url`, and `summary`, plus the fields named on this skill.

## Credits

One successful search uses 1 credit.
An empty search, a failed search, a compound that matches nothing, or no remaining credits uses 0.
No remaining credits returns 402 and does not search.
A missing key returns 401.

# Duaer pathways

Search Reactome pathways through Duaer. Use the pathwayId with proteins.pathway. One successful search uses 1 Duaer credit.

## Call

`GET https://api.duaer.com/v1/data/pathways?q=insulin&limit=10`

Header: `Authorization: Bearer <Duaer key>`

Use an account key or a model API key.

Get a Duaer key: https://skills.duaer.com/keys.md

- At least one search field is required. Fields combine.
- Search with `q` first; use `id` only when you already have it from a result.
- Word searches default to Homo sapiens pathways.
- `q` — words in the pathway name or summary.
- `id` — optional. Reactome pathway id from a result (`pathwayId`), such as `R-HSA-264876`.
- `name` — optional. Pathway name.
- `limit` — optional. From 1 to 20. Default 10.
- Use `pathwayId` as `pathway` when searching proteins. Reuse `pathwayId` in `id` for an exact lookup.
- Open `browserUrl` for the interactive Reactome diagram, or `diagramUrl` for a PNG export.
- Result fields: source, title, url, summary, pathwayId, dbId, stIdVersion, species, browserUrl, diagramUrl, figureUrl, hasDiagram, hasEHLD, isDisease, doi, releaseDate, lastUpdatedDate, compartments, compartmentAccessions, goId, goName, schemaClass. Words and name searches are enriched with Reactome detail, same as an id lookup.

## Result

Each item includes `source`, `title`, `url`, and `summary`, plus the fields named on this skill.

## Credits

One successful search uses 1 credit.
An empty search, a failed search, a compound that matches nothing, or no remaining credits uses 0.
No remaining credits returns 402 and does not search.
A missing key returns 401.

# Duaer genes

Search genes through Duaer. Use the symbol with proteins.gene. One successful search uses 1 Duaer credit.

## Call

`GET https://api.duaer.com/v1/data/genes?q=INS&limit=10`

Header: `Authorization: Bearer <Duaer key>`

Use an account key or a model API key.

Get a Duaer key: https://skills.duaer.com/keys.md

- At least one search field is required. Fields combine.
- Search with `q` or `symbol` first; use `id` only when you already have an NCBI Gene id.
- `q` — words in the gene symbol, name, or summary.
- `symbol` — optional. Official gene symbol, such as `INS`.
- `id` — optional. NCBI Gene id from a result (`geneId`), such as `3630`.
- `species` — optional. Species for words/symbol search. Default `human`.
- `limit` — optional. From 1 to 20. Default 10.
- Use `symbol` as `gene` when searching proteins. Reuse `geneId` in `id` for an exact lookup.

## Result

Each item includes `source`, `title`, `url`, and `summary`, plus the fields named on this skill.

## Credits

One successful search uses 1 credit.
An empty search, a failed search, a compound that matches nothing, or no remaining credits uses 0.
No remaining credits returns 402 and does not search.
A missing key returns 401.

# Duaer variants

Search variants through Duaer (ClinVar / dbSNP via MyVariant.info). One successful search uses 1 Duaer credit.

## Call

`GET https://api.duaer.com/v1/data/variants?q=rs113488022&limit=10`

Header: `Authorization: Bearer <Duaer key>`

Use an account key or a model API key.

Get a Duaer key: https://skills.duaer.com/keys.md

- At least one search field is required. Fields combine.
- Search with `q`, `rsid`, or `gene` first; use `id` only when you already have an HGVS genomic id from a result.
- `q` — words such as an rs id (`rs113488022`).
- `rsid` — optional. dbSNP rs id, such as `rs113488022`.
- `gene` — optional. Gene symbol with ClinVar annotations, such as `BRAF`. Look up symbols with https://skills.duaer.com/genes.md.
- `id` — optional. HGVS genomic id from a result (`variantId`), such as `chr7:g.140453136A>T`.
- `limit` — optional. From 1 to 20. Default 10.
- Reuse `variantId` in `id` for an exact lookup.

## Result

Each item includes `source`, `title`, `url`, and `summary`, plus the fields named on this skill.

## Credits

One successful search uses 1 credit.
An empty search, a failed search, a compound that matches nothing, or no remaining credits uses 0.
No remaining credits returns 402 and does not search.
A missing key returns 401.

# Duaer interactions

Search STRING protein interaction partners through Duaer. One successful search uses 1 Duaer credit.

## Call

`GET https://api.duaer.com/v1/data/interactions?protein=INS&species=9606&limit=10`

Header: `Authorization: Bearer <Duaer key>`

Use an account key or a model API key.

Get a Duaer key: https://skills.duaer.com/keys.md

- `protein` is required. Other fields are optional.
- `protein` — gene symbol, UniProt accession, or STRING id. Look up symbols with https://skills.duaer.com/genes.md or proteins with https://skills.duaer.com/proteins.md.
- `species` — optional. NCBI taxonomy id. Default `9606` (human). Look up ids with https://skills.duaer.com/organisms.md.
- `requiredScore` — optional. STRING threshold from 0 to 1000. Omit for the STRING default.
- `limit` — optional. From 1 to 20. Default 10.

## Result

Each item includes `source`, `title`, `url`, and `summary`, plus the fields named on this skill.

## Credits

One successful search uses 1 credit.
An empty search, a failed search, a compound that matches nothing, or no remaining credits uses 0.
No remaining credits returns 402 and does not search.

# Duaer expression

Search GTEx median tissue expression through Duaer. One successful search uses 1 Duaer credit.

## Call

`GET https://api.duaer.com/v1/data/expression?gene=INS&limit=10`

- `gencodeId` — optional. Ensembl/Gencode id from a result, such as `ENSG00000254647.6`.
- `tissue` — optional. GTEx tissue id, such as `Pancreas` or `Adipose_Subcutaneous`.
- `limit` — optional. From 1 to 20. Default 10. Results are sorted by median TPM descending.

# Duaer targets

Search Open Targets gene–disease associations through Duaer. One successful search uses 1 Duaer credit.

## Call

`GET https://api.duaer.com/v1/data/targets?gene=INS&limit=10`

Header: `Authorization: Bearer <Duaer key>`

Use an account key or a model API key.

Get a Duaer key: https://skills.duaer.com/keys.md

- At least `gene` or `disease` is required.
- `gene` — gene symbol or Ensembl id. Look up symbols with https://skills.duaer.com/genes.md.
- `disease` — optional. Disease name or ontology id (`EFO_` / `MONDO_`). Alone, returns associated targets. With `gene`, filters that gene’s associations. Look up names with https://skills.duaer.com/diseases.md.
- `limit` — optional. From 1 to 20. Default 10. Results are sorted by association score descending.

## Result

Each item includes `source`, `title`, `url`, and `summary`, plus the fields named on this skill.

One successful search uses 1 credit.
An empty search, a failed search, a compound that matches nothing, or no remaining credits uses 0.

# Duaer orthologs

Search cross-species orthologs through Duaer (MyGene HomoloGene). One successful search uses 1 Duaer credit.

## Call

`GET https://api.duaer.com/v1/data/orthologs?gene=INS&species=9606&limit=10`

Header: `Authorization: Bearer <Duaer key>`

Use an account key or a model API key.

Get a Duaer key: https://skills.duaer.com/keys.md

- `gene` is required.
- `gene` — gene symbol or NCBI Gene id. Look up symbols with https://skills.duaer.com/genes.md.
- `species` — optional. NCBI taxonomy id for the query gene. Default `9606` (human). Look up ids with https://skills.duaer.com/organisms.md.
- `orthologSpecies` — optional. Keep only orthologs for this taxonomy id (for example `10090` for mouse).
- `limit` — optional. From 1 to 20. Default 10.

## Result

Each item includes `source`, `title`, `url`, and `summary`, plus the fields named on this skill.

One successful search uses 1 credit.

# Duaer activities

Search ChEMBL bioactivities through Duaer by molecule or target. One successful search uses 1 Duaer credit.

## Call

`GET https://api.duaer.com/v1/data/activities?molecule=aspirin&limit=10`

Header: `Authorization: Bearer <Duaer key>`

Use an account key or a model API key.

Get a Duaer key: https://skills.duaer.com/keys.md

- At least `molecule` or `target` is required.
- `molecule` — molecule name or ChEMBL id (`CHEMBL25`). Names resolve via ChEMBL search. Look up PubChem names with https://skills.duaer.com/compounds.md.
- `target` — optional. Target name, gene symbol, or ChEMBL id. Alone, returns activities for that target. With `molecule`, filters both. Look up gene–disease targets with https://skills.duaer.com/targets.md.
- `limit` — optional. From 1 to 20. Default 10. Results prefer higher pChEMBL values.

## Result

Each item includes `source`, `title`, `url`, and `summary`, plus the fields named on this skill.

## Credits

One successful search uses 1 credit.
An empty search, a failed search, a compound that matches nothing, or no remaining credits uses 0.
No remaining credits returns 402 and does not search.
A missing key returns 401.

# Duaer AlphaFold

Look up AlphaFold predicted structures through Duaer by gene or UniProt accession. One successful search uses 1 Duaer credit.

`GET https://api.duaer.com/v1/data/alphafold?gene=INS&organism=Homo%20sapiens&limit=10`

- `organism` — optional. Used when resolving gene (default `Homo sapiens`).
- `limit` — optional. From 1 to 20. Default 10.

# Duaer drug–gene

Search drug–gene interactions through Duaer via DGIdb. One successful search uses 1 Duaer credit.

## Call

`GET https://api.duaer.com/v1/data/drug-gene?gene=EGFR&approved=yes&limit=10`

Header: `Authorization: Bearer <Duaer key>`

Use an account key or a model API key.

Get a Duaer key: https://skills.duaer.com/keys.md

- Provide `gene` or `drug` (or both).
- `gene` — gene symbol (e.g. `EGFR`).
- `drug` — drug name (e.g. `imatinib`).
- `approved` — optional. `yes` or `no` to keep only approved or unapproved drugs.
- `limit` — optional. From 1 to 20. Default 10. Results prefer higher interaction score.

## Result

Each item includes `source`, `title`, `url`, and `summary`, plus the fields named on this skill.

## Credits

One successful search uses 1 credit.
An empty search, a failed search, a compound that matches nothing, or no remaining credits uses 0.
No remaining credits returns 402 and does not search.
A missing key returns 401.

`GET https://api.duaer.com/v1/data/emdb?words=insulin&limit=10`

Header: `Authorization: Bearer <Duaer key>`

Use an account key or a model API key.

Get a Duaer key: https://skills.duaer.com/keys.md

- Provide `words` or `id`.
- `words` — search words, such as insulin.
- `id` — optional. Id such as EMD-74236.
- `limit` — optional. From 1 to 20. Default 10.

## Result

Each item includes `source`, `title`, `url`, and `summary`, plus the fields named on this skill.

## Credits

One successful search uses 1 credit.
An empty search, a failed search, a compound that matches nothing, or no remaining credits uses 0.
No remaining credits returns 402 and does not search.
A missing key returns 401.
